The '''thermal annihilator bomb'''<ref name="Name">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/kidnapped-concept-art-gallery|text="Kidnapped" Concept Art Gallery}}</ref>  was an explosive device that could be detonated by a trigger remotely. The [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] was approximately the size of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] with its antenna, and had a front panel that could be taken off to access the explosives inside. The resulting explosion could easily destroy a medium-size building, and the bombs were used by [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] during the [[Battle of Kiros]] as a tool to force the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to surrender. However, only one ever went off on [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], because the other bombs were destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], as [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] distracted D'Nar by dueling him.<ref name="Kidnapped" />
